images.note: Frontal symmetrical sage wall, arched brass niche with vase; clean loop frame
Frontal shifted right; charred oak slat panel with LED and cherry branches, black drawer band, boucle pouf
3/4 left; oak coat closet, opal pendant, linocut print, travertine plinth, terrazzo floor
3/4 right; ribbed backlit glass lockers, black hook rail, seagrass basket, terracotta hex floor
Hero: off-axis from doorway, curved plaster alcove with curved bench and stacked Douglas fir totem lamp (takes the drop)
Down the narrow hall, repeating arched niches, herringbone floor, umbrella stand

idea: Eight handleless sage-and-oak mudroom built-in walls for a 2014 Portland townhouse, each from a new angle, one rainy-spring-midday collection ending on a calm fern-and-bench landing.
